explanation: The statement (χ ^ p = χ for a quadratic MulChar when p is a prime characteristic of the target ring) occurs only once in the whole source tree, at Mathlib/NumberTheory/MulChar/Basic.lean:537 (the theorem under judgement itself). A search for `pow_char`, `IsQuadratic`, and `χ ^ p = χ` over Mathlib, Batteries and Lean core turned up no other declaration with this content: the neighbouring results `MulChar.IsQuadratic.sq_eq_one`, `IsQuadratic.pow_even`, `IsQuadratic.pow_odd` and the generic `MulChar.pow_card_eq_one` do not imply it (in particular the p = 2 case of the characteristic is not covered by `pow_odd`, and CharP/ring–character reasoning would be needed), so it is not a special case of any single Mathlib lemma either. The proof uses only the general lemma `neg_one_pow_char` together with basic power facts.
